Description: Wildcard entry under the ModuleNames subkey (not a top-level value of ModuleLogging) that enables module logging for all PowerShell modules; corresponds to setting "Module Names" to * in the GPO
Enable PowerShell Transcription (optional per source guide; set an OutputDirectory value separately to centralize transcript output)
Include command line in process creation events (System > Audit Process Creation)
Audit: Force audit policy subcategory settings (Windows Vista or later) to override audit policy category settings
Maximum Application event log size in KB (4GB)
Retain old events in the Application log (do not overwrite events when the log reaches its maximum size)
Maximum Security event log size in KB (4GB)
Retain old events in the Security log (do not overwrite events when the log reaches its maximum size)
Maximum System event log size in KB (4GB)
Retain old events in the System log (do not overwrite events when the log reaches its maximum size)
